title: The Last Supper
summary: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 22:14-20 and look for how this passage teaches: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.

tell_it: Jesus shared bread and cup with His disciples and told them to remember Him.
understand_it: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Last Supper reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Jesus is the Savior.
age_8_11_explanation: The Last Supper shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.
teen_explanation: The Last Supper gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when jesus is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who told His disciples to remember Him?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Jesus. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Luke 22:19 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Last Supper?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Remember Table
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Last Supper. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
